concept: Hormuz Purple-Team CTF — live-twin GPS pins under ASCII cockpit layers
meaning: A pin is a lat/lon join key. Live feeds paint the twin. ASCII layers are the 60fps HUD. Purple scores CLASS + EVIDENCE, never a live packet.
roe: Sandbox twin only. No packets leave the sim. Classify public anomaly classes. No jam/spoof/OT recipes.

feeds.use: AIS twin tracks → crop-circle / dark-gap / destination-distress CLASS
air tracks near HLS → GCAA 5km legal CLASS
KEV id → /api/cve-to-mission quiz stem, not an exploit

ascii_layers.shape: TARGET_QUIZZES { q, choices[3], correct, cert, card, why }

event_loop: LIVE-TICKER prints SYS AIS TWIN lines from /api/maritime at that lat/lon
fly within 400m of a pin (engine already has this copy on /gulf)
H hold = breach the TWIN not the plant
Purple confirms only if CLASS + public citation match
flag{...} writes .ln.ritual + Hack Card + cert line

how_i_would_show_it.player_view: 3D Hormuz in the empty HUD center; four ASCII layers around it; pins snap to live GPS
how_i_would_show_it.operator_view: same cockpit + Purple score column (evidence quality 0-5)
how_i_would_show_it.spectator_view: top-down ASCII chart, pins as glyphs, ticker of classifications — no weapon cam
how_i_would_show_it.do_not_show: real MMSI targeting, jammer UI, OT write commands, nation flags as teams
